properties.displayName: prod: paid but no order (checkout reconciler)
properties.description: The checkout reconciler reported a payment it could not turn into an order, or gave up trying (the authorization was already captured). Money has been taken for a checkout that has no order.

allOf.query:
traces
| where cloud_RoleName == 'restaurant-ordering-system'
| where message has '[checkout-reconcile:error]' or message has '[checkout-reconcile:give-up-error]' or message has '[checkout-reconcile:captured-without-order]'
